name: ui-render
description: Rich visual output for agents: Adaptive Cards (with inputs and buttons), bar/line/area/pie/donut charts, tables, KPI tiles and Mermaid diagrams, validated as graphrt UI blocks for the host to render

nodes.title: Show an Adaptive Card
nodes.description: Shows the user an Adaptive Card (graphrt UI block; card JSON with type "AdaptiveCard" and version "1.5"). Supported: TextBlock, RichTextBlock, Image, ImageSet, Container, ColumnSet/Column, FactSet, ActionSet, Table, Input.Text/Number/Date/Time/Toggle/ChoiceSet; Action.Submit, Action.Execute, Action.OpenUrl (https or mailto), Action.ShowCard, Action.ToggleVisibility. Images must be https or data: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP. No ${...} templates: write the values into the text. Use it for summaries, receipts and records; buttons only work in a workflow's ask-me-first step (human-input card).

heading.description: Title shown above the block (`title` is a graphrt node key, so it is called heading)

fallback_text.description: Plain text for channels that cannot show it (chat apps, email)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Show a chart
nodes.description: Shows the user a bar, line, area, pie or donut chart (graphrt UI block). Give the categories (x_values) and one or more series with one number (or null) per category, or give rows plus x_key and y_keys. Pie and donut take one series of non-negative values.

chart_type.description: bar, line, area, pie or donut

heading.description: Title shown above the block (`title` is a graphrt node key, so it is called heading)

series.description: Series, each with a name and one value per category, e.g. [{"name": "2026", "values": [120, 150, 90]}]

rows.description: Instead of x_values and series: records, one category per row

x_key.description: With rows: the field holding each row's category

y_keys.description: With rows: the numeric fields, one series each

y_format.description: How values are written: number, compact (1.2K), percent (12.5 means 12.5%) or currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the currency format, e.g. IDR or USD

fallback_text.description: Plain text for channels that cannot show it (chat apps, email)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Show a table
nodes.description: Shows the user a table (graphrt UI block). Give rows (objects) and optionally columns (key, label, format); without columns every field becomes a column. Formats: text, number, compact, percent, currency, date, status (a coloured pill).

heading.description: Title shown above the block (`title` is a graphrt node key, so it is called heading)

rows.description: Records; values are text, numbers, true/false or null

columns.description: Columns in order; each shows the row field with the same key

fallback_text.description: Plain text for channels that cannot show it (chat apps, email)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Show KPI tiles
nodes.description: Shows the user KPI tiles (graphrt UI block): up to 12 items, each with a label, a value (number or short text), an optional format and currency, an optional delta (change, delta_format number or percent), trend (up, down, flat), good (which direction is good) and caption.

heading.description: Title shown above the block (`title` is a graphrt node key, so it is called heading)

fallback_text.description: Plain text for channels that cannot show it (chat apps, email)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Show a diagram
nodes.description:
Shows the user a diagram (graphrt UI block) written as Mermaid text: a flowchart, sequence diagram, state diagram, class or entity diagram, Gantt chart, mind map, timeline, pie, quadrant chart or git graph. Start the source with the diagram type (flowchart, graph, sequenceDiagram, classDiagram, stateDiagram, stateDiagram-v2, erDiagram, gantt, pie, mindmap, timeline, quadrantChart, gitGraph). Text only: no HTML (use
for a line break in a label), no click/link/callback statements, no %%{init}%% directives or front matter, no style/classDef/linkStyle colours (the app themes the diagram). At most 20 000 characters and 500 lines.

source.description: Mermaid text, e.g. "flowchart TD\n  A[Customer asks] --> B{In stock?}\n  B -- Yes --> C[Take order]"

heading.description: Title shown above the block (`title` is a graphrt node key, so it is called heading)

fallback_text.description: One or two sentences that say what the diagram shows, for channels that cannot draw it (chat apps, email)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
